hook_text: A flood, an earthquake and a rugby final. Can you pin all three on a world map?
clip_script: Mbombela, the news map wall. Step one: hear or read the news and find the place name. Step two: look it up in the atlas index. Step three: read its latitude and longitude. Step four: pin it on the world map with the date and a short headline. Durban floods, about thirty south, thirty-one east. Cyclone Idai at Beira, about twenty south, thirty-five east. The Springboks in Paris, about forty-nine north, two east. The world in the news, pinned in degrees.
visual_style: Whiteboard world map on a classroom wall, pins appearing one by one with small headline cards and degree labels.
mood: Lively and current, like a newsroom.
pacing: One news story per beat, each pinned quickly, ending on a crowded map.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and pin one news story from this week on a map.
